package com.ironwise;

import net.runelite.api.gameval.VarPlayerID;
import net.runelite.api.gameval.VarbitID;

/**
 * The game variables Ironwise reads. The plugin sends their raw values; the Ironwise app decides
 * what they mean, so it can learn more without a plugin update.
 */
final class TrackedVars
{
	static final int[] VARBITS = {
		// Account type
		VarbitID.IRONMAN,
		// Spellbook: 0 standard, 1 Ancient, 2 Lunar, 3 Arceuus (Quest Helper's Spellbook enum reads it the same way)
		VarbitID.SPELLBOOK,
		// Prayer scrolls and unlocks
		VarbitID.PRAYER_RIGOUR_UNLOCKED, VarbitID.PRAYER_AUGURY_UNLOCKED, VarbitID.PRAYER_PRESERVE_UNLOCKED,
		VarbitID.PRAYER_DEADEYE_UNLOCKED, VarbitID.PRAYER_MYSTIC_VIGOUR_UNLOCKED,
		// Knight Waves Training Grounds (not in RuneLite's quest list)
		VarbitID.KR_KNIGHTWAVES_STATE,
		// Kingdom of Miscellania
		VarbitID.MISC_APPROVAL, VarbitID.MISC_COFFERS,
		// Daily buys (non-zero once claimed today)
		VarbitID.ZAFF_LAST_CLAIMED, VarbitID.LUNDAIL_LAST_CLAIMED, VarbitID.MORYTANIA_SLIME_CLAIMED,
		VarbitID.ARDOUGNE_FREE_ESSENCE, VarbitID.YANILLE_SAND_CLAIMED, VarbitID.SEERS_FREE_FLAX,
		VarbitID.WESTERN_RANTZ_ARROWS, VarbitID.KOUREND_FREE_DYNAMITE, VarbitID.NZONE_HERBBOXES_PURCHASED,
		// Slayer
		VarbitID.SLAYER_POINTS, VarbitID.SLAYER_TASKS_COMPLETED, VarbitID.SLAYER_MASTER,
		VarbitID.SLAYER_HELM_UNLOCKED, VarbitID.SLAYER_UNLOCK_SUPERIORMOBS, VarbitID.SLAYER_UNLOCK_BOSSES,
		VarbitID.SLAYER_UNLOCK_STORAGE,
		// House
		VarbitID.POH_HOUSE_LOCATION,
		// Rune pouch
		VarbitID.RUNE_POUCH_TYPE_1, VarbitID.RUNE_POUCH_TYPE_2, VarbitID.RUNE_POUCH_TYPE_3, VarbitID.RUNE_POUCH_TYPE_4,
		VarbitID.RUNE_POUCH_QUANTITY_1, VarbitID.RUNE_POUCH_QUANTITY_2, VarbitID.RUNE_POUCH_QUANTITY_3,
		VarbitID.RUNE_POUCH_QUANTITY_4,
		// Tool Leprechaun storage (the app adds the EXTRA* parts to the counts). Not
		// FARMING_TOOLS_SELECTEDQUANTITY: that's the leprechaun window's own state.
		VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_RAKE, VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_EXTRARAKES,
		VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_DIBBER, VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_EXTRADIBBERS,
		VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_SPADE, VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_EXTRASPADES,
		VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_SECATEURS, VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_EXTRASECATEURS, VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_FAIRYSECATEURS,
		VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_TROWEL, VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_EXTRATROWELS,
		VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_WATERINGCAN, VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_PLANTCURE,
		VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_BUCKETS, VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_EXTRABUCKETS, VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_EXTRA2BUCKETS,
		VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_COMPOST, VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_EXTRACOMPOST,
		VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_SUPERCOMPOST, VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_EXTRASUPERCOMPOST,
		VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_ULTRACOMPOST,
		VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_BOTTOMLESS_BUCKET_TYPE, VarbitID.FARMING_TOOLS_BOTTOMLESS_BUCKET_QUANTITY,
		// Achievement diaries: each tier done
		VarbitID.ARDOUGNE_DIARY_EASY_COMPLETE, VarbitID.ARDOUGNE_DIARY_MEDIUM_COMPLETE, VarbitID.ARDOUGNE_DIARY_HARD_COMPLETE,
		VarbitID.ARDOUGNE_DIARY_ELITE_COMPLETE, VarbitID.DESERT_DIARY_EASY_COMPLETE, VarbitID.DESERT_DIARY_MEDIUM_COMPLETE,
		VarbitID.DESERT_DIARY_HARD_COMPLETE, VarbitID.DESERT_DIARY_ELITE_COMPLETE, VarbitID.FALADOR_DIARY_EASY_COMPLETE,
		VarbitID.FALADOR_DIARY_MEDIUM_COMPLETE, VarbitID.FALADOR_DIARY_HARD_COMPLETE, VarbitID.FALADOR_DIARY_ELITE_COMPLETE,
		VarbitID.FREMENNIK_DIARY_EASY_COMPLETE, VarbitID.FREMENNIK_DIARY_MEDIUM_COMPLETE, VarbitID.FREMENNIK_DIARY_HARD_COMPLETE,
		VarbitID.FREMENNIK_DIARY_ELITE_COMPLETE, VarbitID.KANDARIN_DIARY_EASY_COMPLETE, VarbitID.KANDARIN_DIARY_MEDIUM_COMPLETE,
		VarbitID.KANDARIN_DIARY_HARD_COMPLETE, VarbitID.KANDARIN_DIARY_ELITE_COMPLETE, VarbitID.KARAMJA_DIARY_ELITE_COMPLETE,
		VarbitID.ATJUN_EASY_DONE, VarbitID.ATJUN_MED_DONE, VarbitID.ATJUN_HARD_DONE,
		VarbitID.KOUREND_DIARY_EASY_COMPLETE, VarbitID.KOUREND_DIARY_MEDIUM_COMPLETE, VarbitID.KOUREND_DIARY_HARD_COMPLETE,
		VarbitID.KOUREND_DIARY_ELITE_COMPLETE, VarbitID.LUMBRIDGE_DIARY_EASY_COMPLETE, VarbitID.LUMBRIDGE_DIARY_MEDIUM_COMPLETE,
		VarbitID.LUMBRIDGE_DIARY_HARD_COMPLETE, VarbitID.LUMBRIDGE_DIARY_ELITE_COMPLETE, VarbitID.MORYTANIA_DIARY_EASY_COMPLETE,
		VarbitID.MORYTANIA_DIARY_MEDIUM_COMPLETE, VarbitID.MORYTANIA_DIARY_HARD_COMPLETE, VarbitID.MORYTANIA_DIARY_ELITE_COMPLETE,
		VarbitID.VARROCK_DIARY_EASY_COMPLETE, VarbitID.VARROCK_DIARY_MEDIUM_COMPLETE, VarbitID.VARROCK_DIARY_HARD_COMPLETE,
		VarbitID.VARROCK_DIARY_ELITE_COMPLETE, VarbitID.WESTERN_DIARY_EASY_COMPLETE, VarbitID.WESTERN_DIARY_MEDIUM_COMPLETE,
		VarbitID.WESTERN_DIARY_HARD_COMPLETE, VarbitID.WESTERN_DIARY_ELITE_COMPLETE, VarbitID.WILDERNESS_DIARY_EASY_COMPLETE,
		VarbitID.WILDERNESS_DIARY_MEDIUM_COMPLETE, VarbitID.WILDERNESS_DIARY_HARD_COMPLETE, VarbitID.WILDERNESS_DIARY_ELITE_COMPLETE,
		// Achievement diaries: each tier's reward claimed
		VarbitID.ARDOUGNE_EASY_REWARD, VarbitID.ARDOUGNE_MEDIUM_REWARD, VarbitID.ARDOUGNE_HARD_REWARD,
		VarbitID.ARDOUGNE_ELITE_REWARD, VarbitID.DESERT_EASY_REWARD, VarbitID.DESERT_MEDIUM_REWARD,
		VarbitID.DESERT_HARD_REWARD, VarbitID.DESERT_ELITE_REWARD, VarbitID.FALADOR_EASY_REWARD,
		VarbitID.FALADOR_MEDIUM_REWARD, VarbitID.FALADOR_HARD_REWARD, VarbitID.FALADOR_ELITE_REWARD,
		VarbitID.FREMENNIK_EASY_REWARD, VarbitID.FREMENNIK_MEDIUM_REWARD, VarbitID.FREMENNIK_HARD_REWARD,
		VarbitID.FREMENNIK_ELITE_REWARD, VarbitID.KANDARIN_EASY_REWARD, VarbitID.KANDARIN_MEDIUM_REWARD,
		VarbitID.KANDARIN_HARD_REWARD, VarbitID.KANDARIN_ELITE_REWARD, VarbitID.ATJUN_EASY_REWARD,
		VarbitID.ATJUN_MED_REWARD, VarbitID.ATJUN_HARD_REWARD, VarbitID.KARAMJA_ELITE_REWARD,
		VarbitID.KOUREND_EASY_REWARD, VarbitID.KOUREND_MEDIUM_REWARD, VarbitID.KOUREND_HARD_REWARD,
		VarbitID.KOUREND_ELITE_REWARD, VarbitID.LUMBRIDGE_EASY_REWARD, VarbitID.LUMBRIDGE_MEDIUM_REWARD,
		VarbitID.LUMBRIDGE_HARD_REWARD, VarbitID.LUMBRIDGE_ELITE_REWARD, VarbitID.MORYTANIA_EASY_REWARD,
		VarbitID.MORYTANIA_MEDIUM_REWARD, VarbitID.MORYTANIA_HARD_REWARD, VarbitID.MORYTANIA_ELITE_REWARD,
		VarbitID.VARROCK_EASY_REWARD, VarbitID.VARROCK_MEDIUM_REWARD, VarbitID.VARROCK_HARD_REWARD,
		VarbitID.VARROCK_ELITE_REWARD, VarbitID.WESTERN_EASY_REWARD, VarbitID.WESTERN_MEDIUM_REWARD,
		VarbitID.WESTERN_HARD_REWARD, VarbitID.WESTERN_ELITE_REWARD, VarbitID.WILDERNESS_EASY_REWARD,
		VarbitID.WILDERNESS_MEDIUM_REWARD, VarbitID.WILDERNESS_HARD_REWARD, VarbitID.WILDERNESS_ELITE_REWARD,
	};

	static final int[] VARPS = {
		VarPlayerID.QP,
		VarPlayerID.NZONE_REWARDPOINTS,
		VarPlayerID.SLAYER_COUNT, VarPlayerID.SLAYER_TARGET,
		VarPlayerID.SLAYER_REWARDS_UNLOCKS, VarPlayerID.SLAYER_REWARDS_UNLOCKS1,
		VarPlayerID.MISC_QUEST,
		// Combat achievements: one bit per task, 32 tasks per variable
		VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_0, VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_1, VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_2,
		VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_3, VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_4, VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_5,
		VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_6, VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_7, VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_8,
		VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_9, VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_10, VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_11,
		VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_12, VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_13, VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_14,
		VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_15, VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_16, VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_17,
		VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_18, VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_19, VarPlayerID.CA_TASK_COMPLETED_20,
	};

	private TrackedVars()
	{
	}
}
